newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra to issue 400 bln rph bonds-paper.
newsitem.headline: Astra to issue 400 bln rph bonds-paper.

text.p: Indonesia largest vehicle maker PT Astra International will issue bonds worth 400 billion rupiah to restructure the company's short- and long-term loans, Bisnis Indonesia newspaper reported on Tuesday.
The daily quoted president director of PT Danareksa Securitas Agus Projosasmito as saying the firm will become a lead arranger for the bond issue, scheduled for next month.
But he did not give any details.
An Astra spokesman said he did not know of any decision to issue bonds.
"As far as I am concerned, Astra's board of directors has not make any decision yet whether to issue bonds or not," he said.
Last week, Indonesian rating agency PT Pefindo gave an A-minus rating for Astra's long-term loans.

At the time, Astra finance director Rini Suwandi said the company intended to restructure its debt by converting short-term loans to the long-term by issuing bonds, but she declined to give a time frame.
